text:
anna: Quick check — after the sampler tweak we merged this morning I'm noticing a bunch of missing kv-prefix child spans from the prefetcher goroutines. Traces exist for the request root but child spans often don't show up. Anyone seen this pattern? Service=prometheus-prefetcher, otel-go v1.13.0, running on dedicated pods.

mike: Are you sampling in the SDK or at the collector? If sampling happens at the collector you can drop spans locally and they won't appear.

sara: Also check that the goroutines are inheriting context correctly — most missing-span issues are context propagation, not the sampler. Can you paste the sampler config + how you spawn goroutines?

anna: Sampler envs look like this in the canary:
```
OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=parentbased_always_on
OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG=0.5
OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES=service.name=prometheus-prefetcher,env=canary
```
Spawning code is basically: `go prefetch(ctx, key)` where prefetch does `ctx, span := tracer.Start(ctx, "kv-prefetch")` then does work and `span.End()`.

mike: Two quick things: 1) `parentbased_always_on` with an arg is odd — parentbased samplers usually ignore the arg; ensure you're using the correct sampler string for the SDK version. 2) If the root span finishes before goroutines start, parent sampling decision might not be propagated into the goroutine. You need to propagate the context explicitly into the goroutine call site.

sara: Example pattern that works well:
```go
ctx, span := tracer.Start(ctx, "prefetch.batch")
for _, k := range keys {
    k := k
    wg.Add(1)
    go func(ctx context.Context, key string) {
        defer wg.Done()
        // pass the context so sampler decision + traceparent flow into the goroutine
        ctx, s := tracer.Start(ctx, "kv-prefetch", trace.WithAttributes(attribute.String("key", key)))
        defer s.End()
        doWork(ctx, key)
    }(ctx, k)
}
span.End()
```
If you instead create a fresh background context inside the goroutine, you'll get new traces or nothing depending on sampler.

james: Another angle — check the tracer provider initialization. If you create multiple TracerProviders (one per package) or call `sdktrace.NewTracerProvider` after some code has started, you could end up with different sampling behavior. Make sure there's a single global provider: `otel.SetTracerProvider(tp)`.

mike: Also confirm whether the OTEL collector is set to `tail-based` sampling for the service. If you have tail sampling enabled, SDK-level sampling may be set to AlwaysOn but the collector could decide to drop spans. Look at the collector config (pipeline name `traces/prefetch`) or run a query: https://observability.redwood.net/collector/configs (you might need perms).

deploy-bot: deploy #4512: prometheus-prefetcher@canary rolled out (sampler-change).ci: 2026-03-17T10:12Z :rocket:

mike: For quick debugging, force AlwaysOn and pass full context and see if the child spans start appearing; if they do then it's propagation/sampler. You can also temporarily tag spans with `debug=true` so tail-sampler rules match.

anna: Good pointers — I'll try forcing AlwaysOn on canary and double-check we pass ctx to goroutines. If that fails I'll dump a small trace sample and post the raw JSON. Thanks y'all :thumbsup:

sara: If you want, ping me and I can peek at the collector logs for that time window — look for `prefetcher` and `sampling` entries around the rollout. Also check the dashboard: https://observability.redwood.net/dashboards/traces?service=prometheus-prefetcher&view=recent

anna: Will do, thanks — I'll update here after a quick test.
